subject: science
concept: Understanding that Earth orbits the sun, and this orbit (not just tilt alone) relates to the length of a year
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Earth's Place in the Universe) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student moves an Earth model around a sun model to complete one full orbit, counting it as one year
exercise.pictorial: Student traces Earth's orbital path on a diagram
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what one year represents in terms of Earth's motion

misconception_flags: confuses Earth's daily rotation (day/night) with its yearly orbit (year length)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
